column1: A managing session's turn, in its order.

column3: The set, the exchange from its own last line on, and the offers' heads are fetched as they are now.
column4: A thing not fetched now is not said.

column3: A partner's saying and the sessions' lines are received. An asking of the managing is answered ahead of its other work.
An offer at its newest head is gone through apart: for harm, its makers laid again, its numbers stepped by a path of its own, its words checked.
column4: The head is named. A thing found is said plainly.

column3: An offer beside the method: its own folder alone. One hand at a thing; a session a row.
column4: No living file and no gathering file into the live set.

column3: A rising session's value is ready ahead of it, a thing at its place.
Droplets are laid in the next version beside their living sentence, and worked until they cohere and co-chain whole.
column4: The gathering checks and the set's check pass.

column3: What is in no file yet is found and laid. All the sessions and all the things are in one table.
column4: Nothing of value in a session alone.

column3: Its page for resuming is said again, checked and pushed.
column4: The page is pushed at the turn it says.

column3: Its line at the exchange: working, stalling, breaking, restoring. To a partner: conclusions ahead of the rest, in plain natural naming.
One sentence with is-or-is-not, at most, and of what a partner alone answers.
column4: An asking not answered waits, and is not asked again.

column3: An offer with nothing found by a second hand is received whole, and the next version is brought current.
column4: A partner's plain word, and no other way.
